issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type int, but the template hints (and the solution implementation) use a double return type for more precise calculation. This inconsistency can confuse students about which return type to implement and may lead to failing tests or mismatched implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type across artifacts. Either (A) update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double to match the template hint and solution implementation, or (B) change the template hint and the solution implementation to return int and update any explanatory comments accordingly. Prefer option A if precise (fractional) students-per-tutor values are intended.
